evidence_only_guard: Hebrew morphology, Masoretic accentuation, discourse formulae, parallelism, repeated lexemes, pronoun shifts, translation difficulty, ancient-version wording, and internal reuse are boundary evidence only. They select no preferred reading, witness, punctuation, speaker, referent, etymology, identity, date, history, fulfillment, source direction, canon, ethics, territory, politics, or theology. Roots are not meanings; agreement is evidence, never authority.

global_holds.witnesses: MT/OSHB/UXLC, Septuagint, fragmentary Judean-desert evidence where extant, Syriac, Vulgate, Targum, and later witnesses expose pressure but establish no preferred text or source direction.
global_holds.jeremiah_relation: Obad.1.1-Obad.1.6 and Jeremiah 49 share wording/sequence; direction, dependence, common source, redaction, authorship, and date remain deferred.
global_holds.speakers_and_addressees: Reporter, plural hearers, envoy quotation, Yahweh speech, Edom/Esau/Teman, brother/Judah, nations, Zion/Jacob/Joseph, exiles, and saviors/judges are local observations; quotation limits and antecedents remain open.
global_holds.wordplay_and_parallelism: Rising/down, hidden/searching, wisdom/understanding, day, done/done, drink/drink, possess/possessions, house/fire/flame/stubble, mountain/mountain, and possess repetitions are phrase-level evidence only.
global_holds.identity_history_and_geography: All personal, national, place, invasion, exile, chronology, authorship, source-history, and setting questions remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.
global_holds.ethics_theology_and_fulfillment: Violence, day, recompense, drinking, holiness, possession, fire, remnant, judgment, kingdom, territory, modern application, ethics, and fulfillment are not adjudicated.
global_holds.internal_relations: Genesis, Torah, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Joel, Amos, and later reuse are evidence only; no relation automatically creates a seam or decides meaning.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Vision heading, messenger summons, and pride-to-humiliation oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hazon and koh amar open the vision; shemu'ah/tsir and qumu wenaqumah give the summons, then hinneh and second-person address move through proud-height imagery to ne'um-YHWH.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split Obad.1.1 as heading or embassy fragment, or detach Obad.1.2 from Obad.1.3-Obad.1.4.
proposed_chunks.risk: Composite opening, quotation limits, speaker shift, Jeremiah overlap.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The report/summons occasions the humiliation oracle; second-person pronouns and yrd answer the heart's question before the speech formula closes.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Thief/gleaner comparisons, total ransacking, and ally betrayal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Two im comparisons establish expected remainder; ekh in Obad.1.6 overturns it, and kol plus three relationship descriptions culminate in 'no understanding in him.'
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate thief, grape, treasure, alliance, peace, and bread/snare images, or choose mazor as boundary authority.
proposed_chunks.risk: Parenthetical placement, obscure mazor clause, translation variation.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Comparison-to-reversal and the escalating alliance catalogue describe comprehensive exposure; the difficult final clause stays in context.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Day oracle of wisdom and warrior collapse
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Halo bayyom hahu ne'um-YHWH reopens speech; wise/understanding and warriors/Teman form paired capacities removed from the mountain of Esau.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach to ally betrayal without recognizing the renewed formula, or split wisdom from warriors.
proposed_chunks.risk: Rhetorical question, day chronology, lema'an/miqqatel syntax.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The formula is a seam, while parallel losses and repeated har-Esau keep the two verses together.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Brother-violence verdict and cumulative 'in the day' indictment
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Min-hamas opens ground/verdict; beyom recurs through invasion, followed by a we'al/al chain against looking, rejoicing, boasting, entering, seizing, blocking escape, and handing over survivors.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate Obad.1.10 or Obad.1.11, or atomize each prohibition in Obad.1.12-Obad.1.14.
proposed_chunks.risk: Prohibition-versus-retrospective translation, event identity, violence ethics.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Causal opening, event frame, and repeated day/prohibitive syntax form one cumulative indictment.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Day-of-Yahweh expansion and proportional drinking reversal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ki qarov yom-YHWH shifts from the remembered day to all nations; ka'asher...yesheh and gemulek yashuv lead into matching drinking comparison.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Merge with prohibitions, split Obad.1.15 from Obad.1.16, or resolve the plural addressee/drinking image.
proposed_chunks.risk: Day chronology, pronoun shift, drinking metaphor, fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated ki/ka'asher, as-done/done-to-you, and drink/drink make one reversal; antecedents remain deferred.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Uvehar Tsiyyon contrasts the nations; repeated wehayah, house names, fire/flame/stubble, no-remnant conclusion, and ki YHWH dibber carry to a formal close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach escape from the house metaphor, split each house, or merge the geographic register into this speech close.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Peletah/qodesh/yarshu opens the counter-movement; house triad and speech close complete it without deciding referents.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Territorial possession register, ascent/judgment, and kingdom closure
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Weyarshu repeats across coordinated regions/exiles; the list stays cumulative until we'alu moshi'im shifts to ascent/judgment and wehayetah la-YHWH hammelukhah closes.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each geography/people, isolate difficult Obad.1.20, or detach saviors/judgment from kingdom closure.
proposed_chunks.risk: Obscure syntax, place identities, political use, moshi'im rendering.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated possession syntax gives the register one function; ascent and kingdom clauses provide climax while geography, agent, and fulfillment remain open.
